title: Neon Courier
elevator_pitch: A momentum-running platformer about a debt-bound delivery runner who outpaces the city by stringing together perfect dashes through neon rain.

setting.world: A vertical megacity stacked into permanent twilight, lit only by holographic signage and rain-slick neon.
setting.visual_tone: saturated cyans and magentas against deep navy; emissive materials carry the lighting; rain is a character

protagonist.role: A delivery runner working off a debt they didn't sign up for.
protagonist.motivation: Every successful run shaves time off the contract - but the routes keep getting harder.

notes: Seed vision statement. Stays in the Concept Library until Maestro promotes it into active-projects.json.
